name: C and J Farms
tagline: Link to C and J Farms Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Croweandjonesfarms/
description: A family-run pumpkin patch in Route 1, AL, C and J Farms grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
